stem: Which statement explains how the different cell types in the image are formed?

options.label: A
options.text: Each cell type uses its own unique replication process.

options.label: B
options.text: Each cell type expresses different genes at different times.

options.label: C
options.text: Each cell type contains a different part of the original DNA.

options.label: D
options.text: Each cell type has different enzymes to replicate genetic material.

visual_elements: diagram showing a central cluster of cells differentiating into intestinal cells, muscle cells, liver cells, nerve cells, blood cells, and cardiac cells
